final: WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT maj.department, COUNT(i.income_id) as income_count FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id GROUP BY maj.department), avg_share AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(income_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as avg_val FROM dept_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT income_count, (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_share) as avg_val FROM dept_counts WHERE income_count > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_share)) SELECT SUM(income_count) as combined_count, CAST(SUM(income_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as average_share, AVG(CAST(income_count AS REAL) - avg_val) as avg_amount_above_average FROM above_avg
